scripts.copy:shared: rm -rf supabase/functions/shared && cp -r src/shared supabase/functions/shared && pnpm stamp:version
scripts.stamp:version:
printf 'export const engineVersion = "%s";
' "$(git rev-parse --short HEAD)$(git diff --quiet || echo -dirty) $(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%MZ)" > supabase/functions/shared/version.ts
scripts.deploy:functions: pnpm copy:shared && pnpm dlx supabase functions deploy game-create && pnpm dlx supabase functions deploy game-join && pnpm dlx supabase functions deploy game-action && pnpm dlx supabase functions deploy game-state && pnpm dlx supabase functions deploy game-debug && pnpm dlx supabase functions deploy friend-request
scripts.deploy:debug: pnpm copy:shared && pnpm dlx supabase functions deploy game-debug
